title: Delhi High Court issues summons in Abhishek Sharma's personality rights suit, directs removal of offending content
description: The Delhi High Court on Thursday sought responses of individuals and entities accused of violating Indian cricketer Abhishek Sharma's personality rights by publishing allegedly defamatory, obscene and AI-generated content about him..Justice Jyoti Singh said the Court will direct the removal of certain offending online content against Sharma."At this point in time, I will direct their takedown and I will injunct the defendants as we usually do," said the Court.
